product.name: Monoprice Power Cord Splitter - NEMA 5-15P to 2x IEC 60320 C13 16AWG 13A/1625W SJT Black 3ft
product.description: The Monoprice™ universal AC Power Extension Cord Splitter, allows you to connect two devices with C14 connections, such as computers, to one power outlet. It cuts down on cabling, as well as frees up space on UPSs, surge protectors, wall outlets, etc. It is an ideal solution for eliminating extra bulky cords and reducing clutter in a data center.
